resources.string: To dictate, press your action key once and speak immediately. Press it again to stop recording. Hans transcribes the recording and sends the finished text to your current task.

To dictate, tap the microphone and speak immediately. Tap again to stop recording. Hans transcribes the recording and sends the finished text to your current task. The screen microphone appears only when no physical action key is assigned.
For a longer conversation, tap Hans. Say goodbye or ask Hans to hang up to end the call.
You can try either voice feature whenever you want after setup. Practice is optional; setup has not tested a recording or task for you.
Would you like to assign a physical action key? This is optional.
Press the key you want to use for dictation once.
